findings.pdf_says:
Page 1018 (printed 988) opens with the script label and its ranges on consecutive lines:
"Old_Italic:
10300-1031F, 1032D-1032F"
findings.markdown_says: The page-1018 block opens with a headless range, "10300-1031F, 1032D-1032F", with no "Old_Italic:" label. The label was pulled back onto the last line of the page-1017 block, where it is glued to the preceding script's ranges: "10C80-10CB2, 10CC0-10CF2 Old_Italic:" (ISO_COBOL.md line 40558).
findings.why_it_matters: Annex B (normative) "Characters permitted in user-defined words" is a label-to-code-point-range table. The union of code points is unchanged, but the binding of the range 10300-1031F, 1032D-1032F to the script Old_Italic is destroyed: read linearly the markdown shows Old_Hungarian's range line ending in a stray "Old_Italic:" token, followed by page furniture, followed by an unattributed range. Any mechanical extraction of the annex from the markdown mis-associates or drops the entry.
findings.suggested_repair: Split "10C80-10CB2, 10CC0-10CF2 Old_Italic:" at the end of the page-1017 block into "10C80-10CB2, 10CC0-10CF2", and move "Old_Italic:" to be the first content line of the page-1018 block, immediately above "10300-1031F, 1032D-1032F".

findings.pdf_says:
Page 1018 (printed 988) ends with "Psalter_Pahlavi:
10B80-10B91" and nothing further. "Rejang:" is the FIRST line printed on page 1019 (printed 989), directly above "A930-A946".
findings.markdown_says:
End of the page-1018 block: "Psalter_Pahlavi:
10B80-10B91 Rejang:" — with "Rejang:" glued to the end of Psalter_Pahlavi's range line. The page-1019 block then opens with a headless "A930-A946".
findings.why_it_matters: Same normative-annex structural corruption as the Old_Italic case: the script name Rejang is detached from its code-point range A930-A946 and appended to a different script's entry on the previous page. A reader or extractor working page by page sees Psalter_Pahlavi's line polluted and Rejang's range unattributed.
findings.suggested_repair: Split the line into "10B80-10B91" (end of page-1018 block) and move "Rejang:" to be the first content line of the page-1019 block, above "A930-A946".

findings.pdf_says:
Page 1021 (printed 991) ends with "Buginese:
1A17-1A1B". "Buhid:" is the FIRST line printed on page 1022 (printed 992), directly above "1752-1753".
findings.markdown_says:
End of the page-1021 block: "Buginese:
1A17-1A1B Buhid:". The page-1022 block then opens with a headless "1752-1753".
findings.why_it_matters: Annex B list 2) "characters permitted in a user-defined word except as the start character" is normative. The label Buhid is separated from its range 1752-1753 across the page break, so the entry cannot be read or extracted correctly from the markdown.
findings.suggested_repair: Split into "1A17-1A1B" and move "Buhid:" to the head of the page-1022 block, above "1752-1753".
